top_signals.title: Treasury Volatility Set for Biggest Jump in Year
top_signals.summary: A measure of Treasury volatility is heading for its biggest jump in more than a year after bond yields rose to multi-decade highs, jolting the market out of its recent slumber.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Chicago Schools Shed 11,500 Students as Budget Risk Grows
top_signals.summary: Chicago Public Schools’ student enrollment is down almost 4% since last year, threatening to further strain the district’s already stretched budget.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
